cardOverview.overviewText: A Paytm Select variant offering higher cashback, milestone benefits, and exclusive partner perks for loyal Paytm customers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: The Paytm SBI Credit Card Select is protected by Cyber Fraud Insurance Cover worth Rs. 2 lakh, which covers financial loss due to fraudulent usage of your credit card. It strictly excludes lost card liability and protection against counterfeit cards and online fraud.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
